## Peeira (CR 3)

This pale-skinned fey wears a roughspun smock and crude leather slippers. Its shaggy hair is thick, long, and wild, in contrast to its delicate insectile wings.  

**XP** 800  
CN Medium fey  
**Init** +3; **Senses** low-light vision. scent; Perception +10  


**Defense**


**AC** 16, touch 14, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 natural)  
**hp** 48 (6d6+12)  
**Fort** +4, **Ref** +8, **Will** +6  
**DR** 5/cold iron  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** dagger +6 (1d4+3/19–20)  
**Melee** shortbow +6 (1d6/x3)  
**Special Attacks** pact protection, wolf meld  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 6th; concentration +9)  


Constant—speak with animals  

3/day—charm animal (DC 13), longstrider  

1/day—goodberry, lesser restoration, magic fang  



**Statistics**


**Str** 12, **Dex** 17, **Con** 15, **Int** 14, **Wis** 13, **Cha** 16  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 18  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Skill Focus (Stealth), [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +12, Climb +10, Handle Animal +10, Knowledge (geography) +11, Knowledge (nature) +11, Perception +10, Sense Motive +10, Stealth +15  
**Languages** Common, Elven, Sylvan; speak with animals  
**SQ** wild empathy  


**Special Abilities**



**Pact Protection (Su)** Once per round as an immediate action, the peeira can command a wolf to attack a creature targetting the peeira. The wolf, as an immediate action move up to it’s speed and make a single attack against the creature. The commanded wolf must be within 120 feet of the peeira and the peeira must be aware the creature is targetting peeira. If the wolf is in the pack the peeira is bound to, the wolf performs this action only if it fails a DC 15 Will save. Otherwise, the wolf must fail a Will save to perform this action. The save is Charisma-based.  

**Wild Empathy (Su)** This works like the druid’s wild empathy class feature, except the peeira has a +6 racial bonus on the check.
